source: ST0x-Technology/st0x.liquidity dashboard/src/lib/transfer.ts RECOVERY_GUIDE, same commit as this file; regenerate from there, do not edit by hand

modeLabels.live-rpc-only: live RPC — ensure the bot is not driving this same on-chain action
modeLabels.direct-db-live-rpc: direct DB + live RPC — stop the bot / ensure it is not driving this id
modeLabels.direct-db: direct DB — stop the bot / ensure it is not driving this id

commands.description: Re-poll the provider and complete the transfer if it has settled.
commands.whenToUse: A transfer is stuck or failed but the provider may have settled it.
commands.appliesTo: Equity mint / redemption (any non-completed state), failed USDC deposit

commands.description: Re-drive ALL interrupted mints and redemptions (no id; best-effort per transfer, failures reported as counts).
commands.whenToUse: Equity transfers were interrupted mid-flight and need re-driving via the bot.

commands.description: Re-drive a single USDC bridge on the bot's transfer worker.
commands.whenToUse: A USDC bridge stopped mid-flight, before or after the burn.

commands.description: Force a stuck transfer into the terminal Failed state.
commands.whenToUse: A mint/redemption is permanently stuck and unrecoverable.

commands.description: Force a USDC bridge stuck before its burn into Failed. The bot accepts it for an Alpaca to Base bridge whose withdrawal completed, or a Base to Alpaca bridge whose vault withdrawal was not sent. If the Alpaca withdrawal completed, the guard stays held until reconcile-usdc settles the funds. After a Base to Alpaca vault withdrawal, the bot refuses it: stop the bot, run the offline stox fail-usdc-transfer, and move the wallet USDC back by hand.
commands.whenToUse: A USDC bridge is stuck before its CCTP burn and must be terminalized. Check the transfer and verify on-chain that no burn landed first.

commands.description: Mark a terminally-failed equity transfer Reconciled after handling residue manually.
commands.whenToUse: An equity transfer is in a terminal failure and its residue was settled out-of-band (bookkeeping).

commands.description: Mark a failed USDC bridge Reconciled after its funds were settled manually.
commands.whenToUse: A USDC bridge failed after its funds left the source venue, and they were settled out-of-band.
commands.appliesTo: Post-burn USDC failure (DepositFailed, post-burn BridgingFailed, or BaseToAlpaca ConversionFailed)

commands.description: Clear a position's pending offchain order pointer so hedging can retry.
commands.whenToUse: A position is wedged on a hedge order that never resolved.
commands.appliesTo: Position with a stuck pending offchain order

commands.description: Override a position’s net exposure after a manual correction. The target is signed: negative is short, 0 is flat.
commands.whenToUse: The recorded net exposure has drifted from reality and must be set explicitly.

commands.description: Replay all events to reconstruct a corrupted materialized view.
commands.whenToUse: A view became corrupted (e.g. lost updates from optimistic-lock conflicts).

commands.description: Complete the destination-chain mint of a stuck CCTP transfer. A burn Circle has not attested yet fails at once as retryable; rerun it later.
commands.whenToUse: A CCTP burn succeeded but attestation polling was interrupted before the mint.

commands.description: Re-account a missed onchain fill: record the trade and place the hedge.
commands.whenToUse: The bot missed an onchain fill and the position/hedge was never updated.
